channel.description: Latest articles from KDFW – Fox 4 – Dallas-Fort Worth – Bias and Credibility (fox4news.com)

item.title: Motorcyclist killed, passenger injured after fatal Arlington crash
item.description: Arlington Police are investigating a motorcycle crash that left the driver dead and a passenger injured.

item.title: Billion dollar Rio Grande buoy operation gets pushback from residents, scientists
item.description: Some South Texas residents are saying "not in my backyard" to floating barriers the government plans to install along the Rio Grande.

item.title: Man caught repainting rainbow crosswalks in Oak Lawn after state-mandated removal
item.description: A man faces misdemeanor graffiti charges after being caught overnight attempting to restore an Oak Lawn rainbow crosswalk just one day after the city began a state-mandated removal of the displays.

item.title: Fort Worth ISD Takeover: Meet the 9 board managers and new superintendent named by TEA
item.description: Texas Education Commissioner Mike Morath appointed Peter Licata and a nine-member Board of Managers Tuesday to lead Fort Worth ISD through a state takeover.

item.title: Suspect dead, Bowie officer injured in Montague County officer-involved shooting
item.description: A suspect was killed, and an officer suffered minor injuries in a shooting that happened over the weekend in Montague County.

item.title: Dallas Weather: Heavy rain and thunderstorms to impact Easter weekend travel
item.description: Heavy rain and thunderstorms are expected to return to North Texas through Saturday following the region's warmest March in history.

item.title: Tarrant County woman arrested for alleged medical child abuse, fraud
item.description: Kaitlyn Rose Laura faces felony charges for alleged medical child abuse, also known as Munchausen Syndrome by Proxy. Authorities say she faked a child's symptoms to obtain unnecessary surgeries and donations.

item.title: Rapper Pooh Shiesty accused of Dallas armed kidnapping to force release from Gucci Mane's label
item.description: Federal authorities have charged nine individuals, including prominent Memphis rappers Lontrell Williams Jr., known as "Pooh Shiesty," and Rodney Wright Jr., known as "BIG30," in connection with the violent armed robbery and kidnapping of three people at a Dallas music studio.

item.title: Police looking for suspect in fatal Johnson County hit-and-run
item.description: A fatal hit-and-run in Johnson County left a family searching for answers and police looking for a suspect.

item.title: Texas man, former airman pleads guilty to defrauding US Air Force out of $37M
item.description: A former active-duty Master Sergeant of the U.S. Air Force has pleaded guilty to defrauding the U.S. Air Force out of more than $37 million over years of contracting work.

item.title: Rangers offer 9th Inning Rally Sombrero among new menu items at Globe Life Field
item.description: A tenderloin sandwich, hot dogs with biscuits & gravy and a rally sombrero are just some of the new items fans can enjoy at a Rangers game this season.

item.title: Dallas leaders unveil transportation plans for World Cup
item.description: North Texas officials say they're prepared to help over a million people travel to World Cup matches this summer.

item.title: FIFA World Cup: Dallas Arboretum pays tribute to Dutch team with flower displays
item.description: The Dallas Arboretum is using its unique connection to the Netherlands to pay tribute to their soccer team when they play in Arlington during the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

item.title: ICE inspection finds 49 deficiencies at El Paso’s Camp East Montana following migrant deaths
item.description: An internal ICE investigation into the nation's largest immigrant detention facility in El Paso has revealed dozens of dangerous safety and medical deficiencies following the deaths of three migrants in custody.

item.title: Bedford woman sentenced to decades in prison after human trafficking conviction
item.description: A Bedford woman will spend decades in prison after police discovered a prostitution ring being run out of her massage business.
